Legal.cookieBannerText: We use cookies to keep our store running (cart, sign-in) and to understand how visitors use our site. See our cookie policy for details.
Legal.cookiePolicyIntro: This page explains what cookies and similar technologies (such as local storage) we use on Reptiles Concept and why.
Legal.cookiePolicyWhatBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They let a site remember information about your visit, like your preferences or the contents of your cart.
Legal.cookiePolicyEssentialBody: Needed for core features to work: keeping you signed in to your account or the staff area, and remembering the items in your cart and wishlist.
Legal.cookiePolicyFunctionalBody: Remember preferences such as your chosen language (French or English).
Legal.cookiePolicyAnalyticsBody: Help us understand which pages are visited so we can improve the site. We don't sell this information.
Legal.cookiePolicyControlBody: Most browsers let you block or delete cookies in their settings. Note that blocking essential cookies may prevent parts of the site (like the cart or checkout) from working properly.
Legal.cookiePolicyContactBody: Contact us using the details in the footer if you have any questions about this policy.
